question: Who among the following won Formula 1 United States Grand Prix 2022?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Max Verstappen**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Charles Leclerc,** is a Formula 1 driver from Monaco who currently races for the Ferrari team. He has won two races in his Formula 1 career so far.
 
• Lando Norris, is a British Formula 1 driver who races for the McLaren team. He has one race win to his name so far.&l
